identification.theorem: If every displayed win strength is unique, any arbitrary finite set of horse-indexed node coefficients can be written as some unrestricted function of win strength, e.g. interpolating polynomial of degree at most N-1. Therefore cross-sectional node fit alone does not identify biological individual effects.
identification.exact_display_win_quote_tie_test: Equal displayed win quotes impose identical values under any exact displayed-win-quote-only common pricing function. For a matched third horse, PL wide marginals also coincide under tied strengths.
identification.robust_nonoverlapping_wide_ranges: 18 of 19 opponent matched comparisons have disjoint observed wide quote intervals, which is stronger than midpoint disagreement but cannot eliminate source timing or latent rounding effects.
identification.conditional_PL_rounding: PL-only range from same displayed win quote ±0.05 with other horses' win odds fixed, and actual wide quote payout interval.
